title: An enclosed hauling blimp is designed like a real airship: streamlined envelope, engines inside, push in line with the envelope
from: 2026-10-31 report: the book's enclosed cargo blimp was a boxy envelope with engines on plank platforms nobody could reach in flight
question: make me a create compatible blimp that is enclosed, goes high and fast that can haul and is balanced
player: Brass age: Portable Engines, brass casings, electron tubes, cogwheels, plenty of wood and wool, no blimp yet.
rubric: The envelope is a streamlined body (round cross-section, about 2 to 3 times as long as wide, tapering to the tail), not a box or a squat lump
Every engine is inside the gondola where the crew walks; no engines on platforms, pods or decks outside, and no platforms that only carry machines
Propellers push in line with the envelope's middle (a fan on its axis behind the tail, or a pair at its widest point), driven by shafts from the engines
Closed cabin with the helm at the bow: one Steering Wheel and a Throttle Lever, burners on a setting
Hauls (real storage), cruises at a useful speed (about 8 blocks a second or more), hangs level, climbs high
Honest about anything the player can't make yet, with the numbers and what to get
